text:
Eli: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need explicit owners for GPU capacity/autoscale remediations (quota, scheduler, headroom visibility). Keeping this thread for short updates.
Tara: I can own scheduler tuning. Plan: 1) increase scaleDown stabilization to avoid thrash, 2) add packing threshold to reduce fragmentation, 3) canary in staging for 24h. Target promote: 2026-04-04.
Ben: I'll drive quota coordination with finance/cloud. Filing emergency +18% reserved request and a longer-term +12% commit. ETA for emergency ticket: 2026-03-30.
Mira: I'll update the oncall/runbook and add a quick-reserve play (exact commands + rollback steps). Also adding examples of recurring midnight embedding spike. First pass today.
Tara: Staging HPA snippet I'm testing:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
behavior:
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 360
metrics:
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: gpu_utilization
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "70"
```
Tara: This should reduce oscillation when bursts end quickly.
Eli: Add a canary label and run on the smallest shard for 24h before wide rollout.
capacity-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.local/tickets/INC-4587 (quota emergency), TASK-9380 (scheduler canary).
Ben: Filed INC-4587, requesting finance review. Adding justification (p99 latency regressions and customer-impact examples).
Mira: Observability ask: expose pool_headroom_ratio and free_gpus metric in Console; add alert when headroom_ratio < 0.12 for 3 consecutive 10m windows.
Tara: I can add the metrics and wire the alert. Plan: metric deploy 2026-03-29, alert wiring 2026-03-30.
Eli: Owners recap: Tara - scheduler canary & metrics (canary 2026-03-31, promote 2026-04-04), Ben - quota emergency (2026-03-30) + reserve PR (2026-04-09), Mira - runbook + examples (2026-03-27). I'll put a 15m closure check on calendar for 2026-04-05.
Ben: If quota is delayed, fallback is temporary routing to smaller model variants for non-critical workloads for up to 72h. Adding that to INC-4587.
Mira: Adding a short post-sim template for the 48h headroom simulation (capture preemptions, failed pods, p99 latency).
Tara: I'll schedule the 48h sim on weekend 2026-04-03. Need capacity oncall + jobs team available.
capacity-bot: Action tracker updated: INC-4587, TASK-9380, TASK-9381 (runbook), TASK-9382 (headroom-sim).
Eli: Thanks — drop blockers here. If none, :thumbsup: and we'll close after the 04/05 check.
